description: This file implements an approval service for a backend system that manages submission approvals, including features like e-signature validation, segregation of duties, state management, auditing, and evidence collection. It defines the core class 'ApprovalService' along with related exception classes and methods for creating challenges, verifying signatures, approving submissions, and retrieving approval records.

classes.name: ApprovalError
classes.description: Base exception class for approval-related errors.

classes.name: AuthenticationError
classes.description: Exception raised for authentication failures in approval processes.

classes.name: AuthorizationError
classes.description: Exception for authorization failures during approvals.

classes.name: SoDViolationError
classes.description: Exception for segregation of duties violations.

classes.name: SignatureError
classes.description: Exception for electronic signature validation failures.

classes.name: InvalidStateError
classes.description: Exception for invalid workflow state transitions.

classes.name: ApprovalService
classes.description: Main service class managing approval workflows, including e-signature handling, state transitions, audit logging, and evidence management.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] create_esign_challenge( self, user_id: str, intent: str, correlation_id: str )
methods.description: Creates an electronic signature challenge for a user, returning a challenge ID and data.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] verify_esign( self, user_id: str, password: str, intent: str, signature_block: Dict[str, Any], correlation_id: str )
methods.description: Verifies user credentials and signature details, returning a verified signature record.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] approve_submission( self, submission_id: str, decision: str, approver_user_id: str, approver_role: str, signature: Dict[str, Any], correlation_id: str, required_preconditions: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None, rationale: Optional[str] = None, password_for_esign: Optional[str] = None )
methods.description: Handles approval or rejection of a submission with checks for SoD, signatures, and preconditions, updating state and creating evidence.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] get_approval_record(self, approval_record_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves a specific approval record by ID.

methods.name: list list_approval_records(self, submission_id: str)
methods.description: Lists all approval records associated with a submission.

methods.name: str _add_minutes_to_iso(self, iso_timestamp: str, minutes: int)
methods.description: Helper method to add minutes to an ISO timestamp.
